records.title: Fiscal Impact of Tax Exemption for Road Accident Compensation
details: a: The exemption to the interest income under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 to an individual or his legal heir has been proposed by the Finance Bill, 2026 exemption becomes law, the fiscal impact of the exemption may be evaluated.

records.title: Proposed Seed Bill
details: a to d: The proposed draft Seeds Bill is expected to facilitate production and supply of quality seeds and for matters connected therewith, regulate the quality of seeds and planting materials and ensure the availability of quality seeds for farmers; curb the sale of spurious and poor quality seeds for protecting the rights of the farmers.

records.title: Funds for installation of Kavach system in Railway.
details: 11. Currently, 3 OEMs are approved for supply of Kavach System. To increase capacity and scale of implementation, trails and approval of more OEMs are at different stages.

records.title: AMRIT BHARAT STATION SCHEME FOR KERALA.
details:
a to f: Tenders for development works have been awarded and works have been taken up for 33 Amrit stations, including Verkala Sivagiri, Chirayinkeezh and Kasargod stations, located in the state of Kerala. At Verkala Sivagiri station, works of construction of air concourse, main station building, parking area, etc. have been taken up. At Chirayinkeezh station, works of improvement of waiting hall and parking area have been completed and works of additional platform shelters, improvement of concourse, platform surfacing, circulating area, entrance porch, etc. have been taken up. At Kasargod station, works of raising of platform no. 3, improvement of parking area and erection of high mast light have been completed and works for extension of platform shelter, raising of platform no. 1, provision of lift, improvement of station building, porch, platform surfacing, etc. have been taken up.
i) works of south side terminal building (Block-C), air concourse, Foot Over Bridge, platform improvement, platform shelters, etc. have been taken up.
ii) work of improvement of booking office has been taken up
iii)work of circulating area has been taken up
iv) works of parking area at main entry side, lifts, improvement of concourse area, booking office, etc. have been taken up
v) works of architectural improvement of station building have been taken up
